hypotheses.reasoning: Every time notif-worker restarts, it crashes on the same message, msg-453808 at offset 495220, with a stack overflow in expandReferences (most likely a self-referencing template reference). The offset never moves forward, so the worker goes into CrashLoopBackOff and notifications.outbound lag keeps rising. The GC pause at line 227 is not the cause: heap was at 58% after collection and the crashes are not memory errors.
There was a GC pause just before the first crash, but the error is a stack overflow, not running out of memory.

verdict.recommendedAction: Skip msg-453808 (offset 495220) or move it to a dead-letter queue so the worker can resume. Then add a depth limit or cycle detection to expandReferences, and catch per-message errors so one bad message gets dead-lettered instead of crashing the process. Check the template's references for a cycle.
